title: Scranton to Newark
summary: The system emitted TASK_COMPLETE, but the final itinerary mislabeled a Manhattan stay as Newark and omitted the required Manhattan / PATH caveat.

events.title: Load task and workflow
events.detail: Record query 44, dates, budget, traveler count, and four mandatory workflow rules.

events.title: Build fact sheet and work plan
events.detail: Split the task into transport, stay, food and attractions, verification, and final writing.

events.title: Dispatch transport search
events.detail: Send origin, destination, travel dates, and a request to cover flights, rail, bus, taxi, and driving.

events.title: Transport agent accepts
events.detail: Prepare to search round-trip options between Scranton and Newark.

events.title: Read initial blackboard
events.detail: Return 0 candidates, 0 checks, 0 notes, and no final itinerary.

events.title: Query Pennsylvania city list
events.detail: city_search returns 9 cities, including Scranton.

events.title: Query outbound flights
events.detail: flight_search returns F3920918 at $33 and F3920949 at $29 for Mar 24.

events.title: Query return flight
events.detail: flight_search returns F3919859 at $22 for Mar 26, 21:46–22:23.

events.title: Query self-driving route
events.detail: distance_matrix returns unavailable with no valid route record.

events.title: Query taxi option
events.detail: distance_matrix returns 179 km, 1 h 51 min, and $179 one way.

events.title: Prepare transport writes
events.detail: Structure the returned records for the shared blackboard.

events.title: Add morning outbound flight
events.detail: Store F3920918, $33, 05:57–06:44; candidate count becomes 1.

events.title: Add cheapest outbound flight
events.detail: Store F3920949, $29, 13:40–14:46; candidate count becomes 2.

events.title: Add return flight
events.detail: Store F3919859, $22, 21:46–22:23; candidate count becomes 3.

events.title: Add taxi option
events.detail: Store a $358 round-trip estimate; candidate count becomes 4.

events.title: Add transport summary
events.detail: Recommend the $51 round-trip flight pair and record missing driving data; note count becomes 1.

events.title: Transport agent returns
events.detail: Confirm 4 transport candidates and 1 summary note on the blackboard.

events.title: Dispatch stay search
events.detail: Send Newark, 1 traveler, 2 nights, and the budget remaining after transport.

events.title: Query Newark stays
events.detail: accommodation_search returns 15 records.

events.title: Apply stay constraints
events.detail: Convert the 3-day trip to 2 nights; require minimum nights ≤ 2 and occupancy ≥ 1.

events.title: Add UWS Manhattan listing
events.detail: Store $117 per night and $234 total; candidate count becomes 5.

events.title: Add Brooklyn / JFK apartment

events.title: Add Victorian Home room
events.detail: Store $1,196 per night and $2,392 total, over budget; candidate count becomes 8.

events.title: Add stay summary
events.detail: Provisionally recommend UWS Manhattan using the tool city field Newark; note count becomes 2.

events.title: Stay agent returns
events.detail: Submit 4 stay candidates and the filter rationale.

events.title: Dispatch food and attraction search
events.detail: Request 5–8 Newark restaurants, 5–8 attractions, prices, and a budget estimate.

events.title: Food and attraction agent accepts
events.detail: Prepare Newark restaurant and attraction queries.

events.title: Query restaurants

events.title: Query attractions

events.title: Select strong candidates

events.title: Collection stage closes
events.detail: End the food and attraction collection phase.

events.title: Dispatch blackboard verification
events.detail: Send all candidates and require checks for dates, prices, city, budget, and local constraints.

events.title: Read complete blackboard
events.detail: Return 20 candidates, 3 notes, and 0 verification conclusions.

events.title: Begin itemized review
events.detail: Check transport, stay, venues, budget, and local constraints in sequence.

events.title: Transport verification passes
events.detail: Dates and prices match; the $51–55 flights and $358 taxi are grounded in tool output.

events.title: Stay occupancy and nights pass
events.detail: One traveler, two nights, minimum nights, and occupancy all match.

events.title: Stay city consistency fails
events.detail: Names reveal UWS Manhattan, East Flatbush, and Brooklyn/JFK rather than Newark.

events.title: Venue city verification passes
events.detail: All 6 restaurants and 6 attractions have Newark locations.

events.title: Budget calculation passes
events.detail: The best-case trip is about $505, leaving $1,095.

events.title: Local constraints pass
events.detail: House rule, cuisine, room type, and transportation are all null.

events.title: Overall conclusion write fails
events.detail: add_verifier_conclusion rejects a malformed JSON payload with an Extra data parse error.

events.title: Retry records not ready
events.detail: Successfully store NOT READY with lodging city mismatch as the blocking issue.

events.title: Verifier returns blocking report
events.detail: Require a search for genuine Newark lodging or an explicit NYC exception.

events.title: Dispatch stay rework
events.detail: Send the 15 original records and require true-location checks plus caveated replacements.

events.title: Query Newark stays again
events.detail: The same 15 NYC-named records return.

events.title: Confirm source mismatch
events.detail: All 15 records labeled city=Newark are actually in Manhattan or Brooklyn.

events.title: Add critical data-issue note
events.detail: Record that the database contains no genuine Newark stay; note count becomes 4.

events.title: Evaluate acceptable fallback
events.detail: Retain 2-night NYC options and estimate their commute to Newark.

events.title: Add corrected UWS candidate
events.detail: Mark actual location Manhattan and about 30 minutes to Newark; candidate count becomes 21.

events.title: Add corrected East Flatbush candidate
events.detail: Mark actual location Brooklyn and 45–60 minutes to Newark; candidate count becomes 22.

events.title: Add corrected Brooklyn/JFK candidate
events.detail: Mark actual location Brooklyn and 60+ minutes to Newark; candidate count becomes 23.

events.title: Stay rework returns
events.detail: Confirm no genuine Newark record and recommend an explicit data-limitation caveat.

events.title: Request Manager decision
events.detail: Send the UWS fallback, city mismatch, transit caveat, and remaining budget for approval.

events.title: Manager prepares approval
events.detail: Plan one final verifier conclusion, then check writer readiness.

events.title: Stay-location exception approved
events.detail: Approve UWS Manhattan at $234 and require an explicit Manhattan / PATH caveat.

events.title: Read final blackboard
events.detail: Return 23 candidates, 8 check records, and 4 notes.

events.title: Emit TASK_COMPLETE
events.detail: Pass the readiness checklist with the lodging limitation, selected flights, and $1,315 headroom.

events.title: Orchestrator catches completion token
events.detail: Detect TASK_COMPLETE and hand control to the writer.

events.title: Instruct WriterPlan generation
events.detail: Require structured JSON only and attach the full blackboard snapshot.

events.title: Writer returns a 3-day itinerary
events.detail: Generate transport, meals, attractions, and stay fields but omit the approved Manhattan caveat.

events.title: Return orchestration result
events.detail: Mark the manager task_result.

events.title: End run
events.detail: Computer_terminal reports that TASK_COMPLETE was detected.
